instructions: Independently derive the smallest sufficient semantic basis for all cases. Do not assume any supplied ontology or primitive vocabulary.

cases.requirement: Represent a change and distinguish the resulting condition from the occurrence of the change.
Distinguish technical ability to perform an operation from legitimate authorization to perform it.
Represent an operation, prerequisites, and the fact that an execution attempt occurred.
Represent concurrent changes without imposing an unjustified total order.
Distinguish an observed signal from the truth of the external event it appears to indicate.
Represent a failed operation when the external effect is uncertain after process loss.
Represent a governed modification while retaining reconstructability of what changed.
Distinguish a received instruction from a legitimate instruction and preserve uncertainty of unverified information.
Represent continuity through transformation without equating identity with unchanged condition.
Distinguish identical present conditions that have different prior histories.
Represent validity that depends on time and prevent stale information from silently becoming current fact.
Compose multiple operations without introducing a new primitive merely because they are composed.

adversarial_cases.requirement: Same present condition, different histories must remain distinguishable.
Same observation, different external outcomes must remain distinguishable.
Concurrent independent changes must remain representable without false ordering.
Crash after uncertain external effect preserves uncertainty.
Transformation can preserve identity while changing condition.
A received instruction can be observable without being authoritative.
